description: Read the owner's guardrail config and current rolling-24h usage (caps in BRL cents, used, remaining, whether the allowlist is on). Read-only — guardrails are immutable at runtime and no tool can change them (G9).
name: wallet_get_guardrails

allowlist_enabled.description: Whether the owner turned the destination allowlist on (§4.3).

daily_limit_cents.description: Owner-set rolling-24h cap in BRL cents (§4.2).

per_tx_limit_cents.description: Owner-set per-transaction cap in BRL cents (§4.2).

used_cents.description: BRL cents committed in the rolling 24h window.

title: Get guardrails
